_comment: Safe Harbor certification entity config. One file per certifiable LLC. Fields map to the CAHP Compliance Hub lists (Properties Registry / Owners / Ownership Structure) and are auto-filled by export_entity.ps1; anything left as "" prints as an underscored blank in the letter for manual completion. Real, filled copies belong in safe-harbor-output/ (gitignored) — never commit one with a real EIN.

property.description: scattered-site single-family and small multifamily residential rental units
property.addressLine: Scattered sites located in Greenville County and Spartanburg County, South Carolina

_certification_note: The cert is executed by the PROPERTY MANAGEMENT COMPANY managing the property (as authorized agent for the owner), not the nonprofit. relationshipToOwner ties the signer to the ownership; the signature block (Signature/Name/Title/Company) is left blank and filled at signing.
_portfolio_note: OPTIONAL. Include this block ONLY for a group / portfolio filing where one parent owns multiple single-purpose LLCs filed together. When isGroupFiling is true (or you pass >1 rent roll covering different LLCs), the letter is framed for the parent and aggregates all units; each rent roll's 'Property Groups' line tags its units to the right LLC in Exhibit A.
